race.comment: AZUKI (12) goes well here on his home circuit placing in four of five attempts, strips fitter third-up from the spell and gets in well at the weights with the 2kg claim. Ticks a few boxes for a race of this calibre. RUBOLOGY (2) returned to the winners' stall over this track and trip last time out and will have derived a stack of confidence from that victory. Can go back-to-back. SNITZOND (5) loves this course and distance with a win and three placings from just four spins. Has to be included. SHINING PROISIR (10) resumes here but showed enough when last in work to warrant consideration in this contest. May run a race while fresh. STARWARD (11) next in line.
